# Hájsky dvor

> Hájsky dvor is a renovated village cottage from 1857 in Háj, in the Slovak Karst (Slovenský kras) region of eastern Slovakia, rented out as a whole to one group: up to 11 guests in 4 bedrooms. The outdoor hot tub and sauna are included in the price. It is aimed at families with children: a kids' corner with toys and books, a sandpit, a wooden playhouse, a fenced yard and an edible permaculture garden. The Háj waterfalls are 0.8 km away and Košice about 45 minutes by car.

Website languages: Slovak, Hungarian, English, German, Polish, Ukrainian. The hosts speak Slovak and can also communicate in English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Address: Háj 83, 044 02 Háj, Košice-okolie district, Košice Region, Slovakia
- GPS: 48.6298303, 20.8526258
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/eDrvEYHP3DEzSBfe7
- Type: entire house (whole cottage for one group), built in 1857, renovated by the owners with clay plaster, lime and wooden beams
- Capacity: 11 beds in 4 bedrooms: single room with a 90×200 bed and a 70×140 child's bed (adult + child), double room with a double bed and a baby cot, 2× four-bed rooms (double bed + single beds)
- Bathroom: bathtub, washbasin, washing machine and dryer, towels; separate toilet
- Check-in 15:00–23:59 (self check-in), check-out 07:00–10:00; early check-in or late check-out is possible for a €60 fee; the owners do not live on site, only one group of guests at a time
- Included in the price: outdoor hot tub (kaďa) and a wooden sauna cabin in the yard, towels, free Wi-Fi, free parking at the house
- For children: kids' corner with books, toys and a teepee, playground with a playhouse, sandpit, climbing frame, swing, paddling pool in summer, baby cot, high chair, changing table, potty, fenced yard
- Also: edible permaculture garden, fireplace and underfloor heating, covered terrace with grill, fire pit with a cauldron for goulash (firewood is provided, guests bring their own charcoal or grill briquettes), woodshed, garden swing, badminton
- Kitchen: electric oven, ceramic hob, fridge with freezer, kettle, coffee maker, dining table
- Minimum stay: 2 nights, open all year
- Pets: not allowed; no smoking indoors; not wheelchair accessible
- Nearby services: bus stop 100 m, grocery shop 4.7 km, restaurant 4.8 km, train station 5.5 km
- Hosts: Denisa and Tomáš Kapasní
- Phone: +421 908 864 513 (bookings preferably through the portals below)
- E-mail: hajskydvor@gmail.com

## Distances (straight line)

- Háj waterfalls (Hájske vodopády, Hájska dolina gorge): 0.8 km
- Turňa Castle (Turniansky hrad): 3.5 km
- Hrhov waterfall (Hrhovský vodopád): 8.1 km
- Zádiel gorge (Zádielska tiesňava): about 10 km
- Jasov cave (Jasovská jaskyňa): about 21 km
- Košice: about 45 km; Košice airport: about 41 km
- Miskolc (Hungary): 105 km

## Trip ideas by season

- Straight from the house, no car needed: on foot to the Háj waterfalls, along the Angel Road (Anjelská cesta) to the angel statue, to Turňa Castle and into the Zádiel valley; by bike to Hačava
- By car: Hrhov waterfall, Hrhov and Perín fishponds, Granárium, the Hussite church in Lúčka, the plant church in Debraď, Jasov cave
- Spring to autumn: Háj waterfalls gorge with ladders and footbridges, Zádiel gorge, Hrhov waterfall, Jasov cave, Domica and Gombasecká caves (UNESCO), Silica ice cave and the Silica plateau, Krásna Hôrka castle and the Andrássy mausoleum, Betliar manor and park, Granárium (Esterházy granary)
- All year: Turňa Castle, the angel statue on a hill above the village (a prop from the film Behind Enemy Lines), Medzev (observatory, historic hammer mill, summer swimming pool), a slow day at home with the garden, sauna and hot tub
- Winter: Štós – Šikmá stráň ski resort, cross-country ski trails, Košice old town and Christmas markets, sledding in the village
